proof_mechanisms: 1. Define block index b = (x0 - 8) // 10 for x0>=8
2. Even formula: 16 - x0//2 + 36*b; Odd formula: x0//2 + 17 + 36*b
3. Verify b=0 block (x0=8..17) and b=1 block (x0=18..21)
4. For x0<8 need separate triangular formula
5. Check if (x0-3)*(x0-2)//2 gives 1,3,6,10 for x0=4,5,6,7 vs expected 2,7,13,20 - needs adjustment
claim.statement: This hypothesis attempts a unified formula without per-value lookup by introducing a block index b = (x0-8)//10 that shifts offsets by 36 per block. This captures the observed jump from block [8,17] to block [18,27]. The small-value formula needs work but the periodic block structure is the core insight. Draws from Beatty sequence theory and floor-based periodicity.
